 Alonso gives injury update on Caicedo, Joao Pedro, James, Gittens and more 
 Fri, 20 Nov, 2026 Alonso gives injury update on Caicedo, Joao Pedro, James, Gittens and more 
 By Will Faulks 
 Add as preferred source on Google 
 Add as preferred source 
 Add as preferred source on Google 
 Xabi Alonso has given a wide-ranging injury update on his Chelsea squad after the international break. 
 If you enjoy Talk Chelsea coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content. 
 Xabi Alonso has just taken his first press conference following the November international break, and the two weeks off have given space for major injury updates.
 The priority for everyone is finding out how Joao Pedro is. Nobody was expecting him to be back for this game, but we just wanted to know how he’s getting on with his recovery:
 “Not yet,” Alonso replied when asked if the striker would be back for tomorrow’s game.
 “He’s not fit yet to train with the team. He’s not going to be available for Leeds. We need to see game by game how he’s feeling.”
 If he’s not training with the team yet, we can only assume there are still a few weeks to wait.
 Alonso rattles through full squad update
 Xabi Alonso in a home press conference. To rattle through the other players: Maxence Lacroix is in a “similar situation to Joao.”
 Moises Caicedo came off early for Ecuador earlier this week but is “available for tomorrow.”
 Jamie Gittens is “better” and training with the team, but still needs “more time” to build up fitness. Reece James is “getting there” after his latest surgery, but is “still some weeks away.”
 Finally, Josh Acheampong is fit to return, while Jorrel Hato is still out.
 In other news…
 Juan Mata has retired – and told Gary Lineker a funny story about how Petr Cech had “saved his life” in the 2012 Champions League final. 
 Chelsea are looking to sign a Bayern Munich goalkeeping talent – and they already have a loan plan in place for him.
